summary: Deep pass over html-portfolio's Gurukul lineage: origin/voice-cloning -> gurukul-ws-v..ws-as -> claude/gurukul-platform (tip 771feef9, 2026-08-28). All 20 ws branches are fully merged into GP (0 unique commits each); the chain ranges were read commit by commit (263 commits, bodies dumped and read for the voice/pipeline/UX range; the last 26 owner-account commits have empty bodies and are documented only through the context/*.md entries they append). Complements docs/harvest/gurukul.md (product arc, practice engine, teacher sheet, safety floor, Azure gotchas, headline bake-off) and goes deeper on what it skipped. What this lineage built and how far it got: (1) an 8-step audio enrollment DAG (integrity, malware_scan, media_probe, diarize, separate, enhance, transcribe, voice_quality) run by an Azure Container Apps Job with lease/settle, stable-jitter retries, and capability-absence codes; it completed end to end on a real 822.72 s upload and on a 1:49:31 / 262 MB lecture (1,683 speaker segments, 288 transcript spans) after fixing four hidden blockers (no caller, a data-modifying CTE that could never commit, packaging, sign-before-cold-start). (2) A private GPU voice-evidence service: Silero VAD + ECAPA greedy online clustering diarizer (cosine 0.68, <=4 speakers, target_likelihood 0.5 by design), Sepformer separation, DeepFilterNet3 enhancement, VAD-based signal quality; plus chunked overlapping diarization for long media with conservative label reconciliation. (3) Pure, deterministic 10 s window scoring and a reference-window selector; the clone's reference had been '8 kHz audio wearing a 24 kHz label' (0.000458% energy >=8 kHz -> 0.0224% after fix, ~49x). (4) Synthesis-lane mechanics: CPU HMAC admission broker that re-signs after readiness, wake-then-sign, a warm/warming/cold state machine with honest 202s (10 polls / 300 s), script-mode CFG conditioning, a reviewed Hindi text frontend, codepoint-normalised IndicF5 durations, receipts and watermark framing. (5) Listening instruments with zero listeners: earbench (HMAC-blinded ABX, four-cell counterbalance, catch trials, Wilson CI, three verdicts with a 0.65 equivalence bound), sealed exact-text packs with capability-shaped cells, peak-safe loudness, spend reservation ledger, and an in-app blind experiment with RSA-attested reports. (6) Mirror Call mechanics (proposal budget 3/min, named evidence bands, PII scrub, selection-not-accumulation) that transfer to learning-profile discovery. (7) Honest-UX primitives (you/us blocker type, one job shape, no fake percentage). The product goal failed: the cloned Hindi voice still sounded foreign and no human panel ever ran. For Taxila (stock realtime voices, no cloning) the value is the DAG/worker discipline, diarization and signal-quality analysis for session audio, format/bandwidth gates, cold-start honesty, the listening instruments for choosing a voice with child/parent listeners, the hypothesis-with-n learning mechanics, and ~60 rejections.

concepts.name: Selection, not accumulation
concepts.description: A pipeline whose inputs grow is not a pipeline that learns; read the consumer's truncation before building accumulation.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Learning profile and memory slots are bounded; only what is selected matters.

concepts.name: Wake, then sign
concepts.description: Never put a signature, timeout or user wait inside an unbounded cold start; wake on an unauthenticated readiness route, then sign; brokers re-sign internally.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Any self-hosted or slow model behind Vercel functions.

concepts.name: Capability absence is not a failed input
concepts.description: Named absence codes route to 'waiting on us' and requeue automatically; real failures ask for a new input.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Parent dashboard and module generation states.

concepts.name: Scoring bandwidth is not delivery bandwidth
concepts.description: A buffer built for measuring must never be the buffer shipped; re-cut from the original.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Audio pipelines for realtime 24 kHz PCM16.

concepts.name: Identity needs an anchor
concepts.description: Without an enrolled reference a speaker cluster's likelihood is 0.5 = unknown, never a measurement.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Any 'did the child answer?' signal needs consented enrollment and a child-voice benchmark.

concepts.name: Conservative split over guessed merge
concepts.description: When reconciling labels across chunks, ambiguous boundaries create new identities rather than merging.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Long-session diarization and any entity resolution in memory.

concepts.name: Calibrate on real bytes
concepts.description: Thresholds are set between real broken and real fixed measurements, never from intuition.

concepts.name: Three-verdict equivalence testing
concepts.description: distinguishable / indistinguishable (CI under a bound) / inconclusive with trials needed; not-significant is not equivalence.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Voice choice and any A/B on pedagogy.

concepts.name: Exact-text, capability-shaped cells
concepts.description: Only identical target text in one language forms a comparison; do not fabricate missing provider capabilities.

concepts.name: Hypothesis with n and a named band
concepts.description: Mined claims carry occurrence counts and a band (supported/weak/below floor), never a decimal confidence.

concepts.name: Proposals at a budget
concepts.description: 3 per minute, feature questions over label questions, surplus deferred to review, nothing applied without an ack.

concepts.name: Reuse only when invariants are shared
concepts.description: Reuse the narrow protocol, not a broad selection that can violate a caller's security property.

concepts.name: Do not fit the grader; treatments include side effects
concepts.description: Exclude the measuring model from training; side effects on shared state (RNG) are part of the treatment.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Any tuning against Taxila's own comprehension metrics.

concepts.name: Prove a lever is connected
concepts.description: Before sweeping a parameter, set it to a value whose failure is unmistakable and different.

concepts.name: Content-free diagnostics
concepts.description: Type + safe message + repo frame makes opaque failures debuggable without logging user data.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Child data privacy with debuggable ops.

concepts.name: Cost reservation before network
concepts.description: Reserve a fixed amount per attempt in a ledger before the call; refuse past a hard stop.
concepts.taxila_relevance: Generation budgets (gpt-image-2, modules) per child and per experiment.

concepts.name: Honesty split as a type
concepts.description: 'Waiting on you' vs 'waiting on us' encoded in types with blame/opaque-count detectors; unknown defaults to 'us'.
